comments.story: Exploring the eerie beauty of Japan's abandoned villages
comments.why: Renovating a traditional Japanese house: taxes, paperwork, family tradeoffs
comments.text: If you are interested in buying an abandoned home in the Japan countryside highly recommend the YouTube channel Tokyo Llama. He's spent the last four years renovating a beautiful traditional style Japanese house and property about an hour outside of Tokyo. He talks about the renovation aspects, taxes, paperwork process, and the pros and cons of doing this with a family. Lots of videos the watch. [VIDEO]
